t: When you have had to walk away from everything
a: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
p: Rabbanā ātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wa hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā.
m: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
